display_long_description:
VOID GUNNER drops you into a neon starfield arena with a plasma blaster in each hand. One rule: aim, blast, survive.

Drone swarms close in across an endless escalation of waves. Squeeze each trigger independently to fire streaking energy bolts — dual-wield to cover two lanes, or focus fire to break the heavies. Every hand runs its own HEAT budget: fire too fast and the blaster overheats and locks until it vents, so trigger discipline matters as much as aim.

Chain your kills. A tight combo window multiplies your score x2, x4, x8 — keep the streak alive and it climbs fast. Let a drone breach the line and it drains your energy core; hit zero and the arena goes down.

FEATURES
- Dual-wield trigger-fire combat — a blaster on each hand, fully independent
- Heat / overheat system rewards controlled bursts over spray-and-pray
- Combo multiplier scoring (x2 / x4 / x8) and a global best-score chase
- Endless escalating drone waves plus boss waves
- Three enemy types and three difficulty tiers
- A neon-starfield arena — iridescent planet, derelict station, cyan grid platform
- Coins, upgrades and a shop; climb the leaderboards

Standing or seated, controller-first, comfortable for short or long sessions. Aim. Blast. Survive.
